info.title: FitPulse API
info.description:
REST API of FitPulse (Node.js, Express and MySQL). Every response body is JSON: successful responses wrap the result in data and failed responses return error.message.

To try protected endpoints: run POST /sessions, copy accessToken and paste it in the Authorize button.
